30

questions.solution_en:
Let usual speed of the person be 7x
Speed of the person after decreasing = 5x
Ratio of usual speed to after decreasing = 7x ∶ 5x
Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 5x ∶ 7x
7x – 5x = 10
⇒ x = 5
5x = 5 × 5 = 25 min

घटने के बाद सामान्य समय का अनुपात = 5x ∶ 7x
7x – 5x = 10
⇒ x = 5
5x = 5 × 5 = 25 मिनट

questions.q_en: What is the difference between the compound interest, when interest is compounded 5-monthly, and the simple interest on a sum of ₹12,000 for years at 12% per annum?
questions.q_hi: ₹12,000 की राशि पर वर्ष के लिए 12% प्रति वर्ष की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच क्या अंतर है?
options_en: ₹90
₹91.50
₹90
₹92.50
questions.solution_en:
When the interest is compounded 5 monthly for years or 15 months the 3 cycles of interest will be there
Effective R% = 12%× =5%
Net effective for 2 cycles = 5+5+ = 10.25%
Net rate for 3 years= 10.25+5+ =15.25% +0.5125 =15.7625%
Net Rate for SI of year at the rate 12% = 15%
Difference b/w CI and SI = 15.7625% 15% = 0.7625%
Required difference= ₹12,000 ×0.7625% = ₹91.50
questions.solution_hi:
जब ब्याज साल या 15 महीने के लिए 5 मासिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर मिलता है, तो ब्याज के 3 चक्र होंगे
प्रभावी R% = 12%× =5%
2 चक्रों के लिए शुद्ध प्रभावी = 5+5+ = 10.25%
3 वर्षों के लिए शुद्ध दर = 10.25+5+ =15.25% +0.5125 =15.7625%
वर्ष की साधारण ब्याज दर 12% = 15%
चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच अंतर = 15.7625% - 15% = 0.7625%
आवश्यक अंतर = ₹12,000 ×0.7625% = ₹91.50
